items.title: Microsoft Three-Layer LLM Routing Architecture for AI Agents on AKS
items.summaryShort: Microsoft Three-Layer LLM Routing Architecture for AI Agents on AKS. Microsoft has released a reference architecture for routing agent traffic on Azure Kubernetes Service.

items.title: Cloudflare Makes Internal DNS Generally Available
items.summaryShort: Cloudflare Makes Internal DNS Generally Available. Cloudflare has launched its Internal DNS service, providing authoritative and recursive DNS for private networks.

items.title: Presentation: Getting Rid of LeetCode Interviews in the World of AI
items.summaryShort: Presentation: Getting Rid of LeetCode Interviews in the World of AI. Daniel Doubrovkine explains why traditional LeetCode whiteboard interviews fail to evaluate senior engineering talent.

items.title: Article: Securing MCP in Production: Defense-in-Depth Beyond the Gateway
items.summaryShort: Article: Securing MCP in Production: Defense-in-Depth Beyond the Gateway. This article presents a defense-in-depth approach for securing Model Context Protocol (MCP) deployments in production.

items.title: .NET 11 Preview 6 Modernises MAUI CollectionView and Android Shell
items.summaryShort: .NET 11 Preview 6 Modernises MAUI CollectionView and Android Shell. Microsoft has released .NET 11 Preview 6 with several architectural and reliability improvements for .NET MAUI.

items.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
items.summaryShort: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever. Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
items.summaryShort: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years. As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
